neighbours.label: the token that opens a written number: Arabic-Indic digit zero '٠' inside a number, and the separate space token before a digit string (e.g. 'died in 1519')

notes: Card: ' ' x21 (space token right before digits: 'died in 1519', 'мая 2012') and Arabic-Indic '٠' x6 at the top (max 516). Logit suppresses digits/eight/nine. Fire mixes Arabic-Indic numbers containing ٠ and years after a word; near misses write the same dates and quantities in words.
